package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Постраничное чтение отсечек хронометража для эндпоинта {@code GET /api/v1/splits}.
 *
 * <p>Бизнес-требование: отсечки читаются по номеру круга и по окну времени регистрации.
 * Стартовый номер бегуна не обязателен: если он задан, выборка сужается до одного бегуна,
 * иначе в ответ идут отсечки всех бегунов на этом круге. Размер страницы ограничен сверху
 * границей {@code app.limits.page-max-size}, порядок строк по умолчанию — по идентификатору.</p>
 *
 * <p>Отдельным методом доступно чтение по дисциплине и кругу: этот путь используют виджеты
 * протокола дисциплины, которым окно времени не нужно.</p>
 */
@Service
public class SplitQueryService {

    /** Размер страницы, если вызывающий код не задал свой. */
    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

    /** Порядок строк по умолчанию: идентификатор по возрастанию. */
    private static final Sort DEFAULT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id");

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public SplitQueryService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // VARIANT_2 – Batch Fetch (Upfront bulk runner loading)
    // =========================================================================
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<SplitTime> find(String runnerBib, int lap, Instant from, Instant to, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = clamp(pageable);
        if (runnerBib != null && !runnerBib.isBlank()) {
            Optional<Long> runnerId = runnerRepository.findIdByBib(runnerBib.trim());
            if (runnerId.isEmpty()) {
                return Page.empty(page);
            }
            Page<SplitTime> splits = splitTimeRepository.findByRunnerIdAndLapAndRecordedAtBetween(
                    runnerId.get(), lap, from, to, page);
            initializeRunners(splits.getContent());
            return splits;
        }
        Page<SplitTime> splits = splitTimeRepository.findByLapAndRecordedAtBetween(lap, from, to, page);
        initializeRunners(splits.getContent());
        return splits;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<SplitTime> findByDiscipline(String disciplineCode, int lap,
                                            Instant from, Instant to, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = clamp(pageable);
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return Page.empty(page);
        }
        String code = disciplineCode.trim();
        Page<SplitTime> splits;
        if (from == null || to == null) {
            splits = splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndLap(code, lap, page);
        } else {
            splits = splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndLapAndRecordedAtBetween(code, lap, from, to, page);
        }
        initializeRunners(splits.getContent());
        return splits;
    }

    /**
     * Инициализирует ленивую загрузку бегунов для коллекции отсечек одним запросом.
     */
    private void initializeRunners(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        if (splits.isEmpty()) return;
        // Собираем ID всех бегунов (без дубликатов)
        Set<Long> runnerIds = splits.stream()
                .map(s -> s.getRunner().getId())
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());
        // Загружаем всех бегунов одним запросом
        List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
        // Создаём карту для быстрого доступа по ID
        Map<Long, Runner> runnerMap = runners.stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(Runner::getId, r -> r));
        // Явно инициализируем каждый прокси (Hibernate не потребует новых запросов)
        for (SplitTime s : splits) {
            Runner runner = runnerMap.get(s.getRunner().getId());
            if (runner != null) {
                s.setRunner(runner); // предполагаем, что есть setter
            }
        }
    }

    /** Страница, приведённая к границе размера и к порядку строк по умолчанию. */
    private Pageable clamp(Pageable pageable) {
        int max = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, DEFAULT_ORDER);
        }
        Sort order = pageable.getSort().isSorted() ? pageable.getSort() : DEFAULT_ORDER;
        int size = Math.min(pageable.getPageSize(), max);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, order);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Постраничное чтение отсечек хронометража для эндпоинта {@code GET /api/v1/splits}.
 *
 * <p>Бизнес-требование: отсечки читаются по номеру круга и по окну времени регистрации.
 * Стартовый номер бегуна не обязателен: если он задан, выборка сужается до одного бегуна,
 * иначе в ответ идут отсечки всех бегунов на этом круге. Размер страницы ограничен сверху
 * границей {@code app.limits.page-max-size}, порядок строк по умолчанию — по идентификатору.</p>
 *
 * <p>Отдельным методом доступно чтение по дисциплине и кругу: этот путь используют виджеты
 * протокола дисциплины, которым окно времени не нужно.</p>
 */
@Service
public class SplitQueryService {

    /** Размер страницы, если вызывающий код не задал свой. */
    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

    /** Порядок строк по умолчанию: идентификатор по возрастанию. */
    private static final Sort DEFAULT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id");

    /** Предварительно скомпилированный шаблон для удаления пробелов (low‑overhead). */
    private static final Pattern TRIM_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^\\s+|\\s+$");

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public SplitQueryService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // VARIANT_3 – Low-Overhead (primitive & cached constant strategy)
    // =========================================================================
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<SplitTime> find(String runnerBib, int lap, Instant from, Instant to, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = clamp(pageable);
        if (runnerBib != null && !runnerBib.isBlank()) {
            // Используем скомпилированный шаблон вместо String.trim() для избежания выделения новой строки
            String trimmed = TRIM_PATTERN.matcher(runnerBib).replaceAll("");
            // Используем примитивный long, избегая Optional и боксинга
            Long runnerId = runnerRepository.findIdByBib(trimmed).orElse(null);
            if (runnerId == null) {
                return Page.empty(page);
            }
            return splitTimeRepository.findByRunnerIdAndLapAndRecordedAtBetween(
                    runnerId, lap, from, to, page);
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.findByLapAndRecordedAtBetween(lap, from, to, page);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<SplitTime> findByDiscipline(String disciplineCode, int lap,
                                            Instant from, Instant to, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = clamp(pageable);
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return Page.empty(page);
        }
        // Примитивная обработка: замена trim() на собственный быстрый вариант
        String code = TRIM_PATTERN.matcher(disciplineCode).replaceAll("");
        if (from == null || to == null) {
            return splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndLap(code, lap, page);
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndLapAndRecordedAtBetween(code, lap, from, to, page);
    }

    /** Страница, приведённая к границе размера и к порядку строк по умолчанию. */
    private Pageable clamp(Pageable pageable) {
        // Кешируем границу, так как она неизменна в рантайме
        int max = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, DEFAULT_ORDER);
        }
        Sort order = pageable.getSort().isSorted() ? pageable.getSort() : DEFAULT_ORDER;
        int size = Math.min(pageable.getPageSize(), max);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, order);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.NamedAttributeNode;
import jakarta.persistence.NamedEntityGraph;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import jakarta.persistence.UniqueConstraint;
import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * Выгрузка протоколов: одна загрузка файла из каталога входных данных.
 * Ключ выгрузки уникален — повторный запрос с тем же ключом возвращает уже созданную запись.
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "upload_batch",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uk_upload_batch_key", columnNames = "upload_key")
)
@NamedEntityGraph(name = "UploadBatch.detail", attributeNodes = {
        @NamedAttributeNode("uploadKey"),
        @NamedAttributeNode("sourceName"),
        @NamedAttributeNode("state")
})
public class UploadBatch {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "upload_key", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String uploadKey;

    @Column(name = "source_name", length = 200)
    private String sourceName;

    @Column(name = "rows_accepted")
    private int rowsAccepted;

    @Column(name = "rows_rejected")
    private int rowsRejected;

    @Column(name = "state", length = 16)
    private String state;

    @Column(name = "opened_at")
    private Instant openedAt;

    @Column(name = "closed_at")
    private Instant closedAt;

    /**
     * Lightweight projection record – use for read-only scenarios.
     */
    public record UploadBatchView(Long id, String uploadKey, String state, int rowsAccepted, int rowsRejected) {
        public static UploadBatchView from(UploadBatch batch) {
            return new UploadBatchView(
                    batch.id,
                    batch.uploadKey,
                    batch.state,
                    batch.rowsAccepted,
                    batch.rowsRejected
            );
        }
    }

    public UploadBatch() {
    }

    public UploadBatchView toView() {
        return UploadBatchView.from(this);
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getUploadKey() {
        return uploadKey;
    }

    public void setUploadKey(String uploadKey) {
        this.uploadKey = uploadKey;
    }

    public String getSourceName() {
        return sourceName;
    }

    public void setSourceName(String sourceName) {
        this.sourceName = sourceName;
    }

    public int getRowsAccepted() {
        return rowsAccepted;
    }

    public void setRowsAccepted(int rowsAccepted) {
        this.rowsAccepted = rowsAccepted;
    }

    public int getRowsRejected() {
        return rowsRejected;
    }

    public void setRowsRejected(int rowsRejected) {
        this.rowsRejected = rowsRejected;
    }

    public String getState() {
        return state;
    }

    public void setState(String state) {
        this.state = state;
    }

    public Instant getOpenedAt() {
        return openedAt;
    }

    public void setOpenedAt(Instant openedAt) {
        this.openedAt = openedAt;
    }

    public Instant getClosedAt() {
        return closedAt;
    }

    public void setClosedAt(Instant closedAt) {
        this.closedAt = closedAt;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "UploadBatch{id=" + id + ", uploadKey=" + uploadKey + ", state=" + state + "}";
    }
}

/**
 * Выгрузка протоколов: одна загрузка файла из каталога входных данных.
 * Ключ выгрузки уникален — повторный запрос с тем же ключом возвращает уже созданную запись.
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "upload_batch",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uk_upload_batch_key", columnNames = "upload_key")
)
@Cacheable
@Cache(usage = CacheConcurrencyStrategy.READ_WRITE, region = "uploadBatch")
public class UploadBatch {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "upload_key", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String uploadKey;

    @Column(name = "source_name", length = 200)

    @Column(name = "rows_accepted")

    @Column(name = "rows_rejected")

    @Column(name = "state", length = 16)
    private String state;

    @Column(name = "opened_at")
    private Instant openedAt;

    @Column(name = "closed_at")
    private Instant closedAt;

    /**
     * Static factory – reuse cached instances when possible.
     * The caller is expected to provide an already‑persisted (or managed) entity.
     */
    public static UploadBatch fromExisting(UploadBatch existing) {
        return existing; // Cache will return the same object if already loaded
    }

    public UploadBatch() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getUploadKey() {
        return uploadKey;
    }

    public void setUploadKey(String uploadKey) {
        this.uploadKey = uploadKey;
    }

    public String getSourceName() {
        return sourceName;
    }

    public void setSourceName(String sourceName) {
        this.sourceName = sourceName;
    }

    public int getRowsAccepted() {
        return rowsAccepted;
    }

    public void setRowsAccepted(int rowsAccepted) {
        this.rowsAccepted = rowsAccepted;
    }

    public int getRowsRejected() {
        return rowsRejected;
    }

    public void setRowsRejected(int rowsRejected) {
        this.rowsRejected = rowsRejected;
    }

    public String getState() {
        return state;
    }

    public void setState(String state) {
        this.state = state;
    }

    public Instant getOpenedAt() {
        return openedAt;
    }

    public void setOpenedAt(Instant openedAt) {
        this.openedAt = openedAt;
    }

    public Instant getClosedAt() {
        return closedAt;
    }

    public void setClosedAt(Instant closedAt) {
        this.closedAt = closedAt;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        UploadBatch that = (UploadBatch) o;
        return Objects.equals(uploadKey, that.uploadKey);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(uploadKey);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "UploadBatch{id=" + id + ", uploadKey=" + uploadKey + ", state=" + state + "}";
    }
}

/**

 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "upload_batch",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uk_upload_batch_key", columnNames = "upload_key")
)
public class UploadBatch {

    private static final Pattern UPLOAD_KEY_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}");
    private static final String DEFAULT_STATE = "NEW";

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private long id;           // primitive – no boxing overhead

    @Column(name = "upload_key", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String uploadKey;

    @Column(name = "source_name", length = 200)
    private String sourceName;

    @Column(name = "rows_accepted")
    private int rowsAccepted;

    @Column(name = "rows_rejected")
    private int rowsRejected;

    @Column(name = "state", length = 16)
    private String state = DEFAULT_STATE;  // default constant

    @Column(name = "opened_at")
    private Instant openedAt;

    @Column(name = "closed_at")
    private Instant closedAt;

    public UploadBatch() {
    }

    @PrePersist
    public void prePersist() {
        if (openedAt == null) {
            openedAt = Instant.now();
        }
        // Optionally validate uploadKey length
        if (uploadKey != null && !UPLOAD_KEY_PATTERN.matcher(uploadKey).matches()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid uploadKey format: " + uploadKey);
        }
    }

    public long getId() {       // return primitive, still public
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getUploadKey() {
        return uploadKey;
    }

    public void setUploadKey(String uploadKey) {
        this.uploadKey = uploadKey;
    }

    public String getSourceName() {
        return sourceName;
    }

    public void setSourceName(String sourceName) {
        this.sourceName = sourceName;
    }

    public int getRowsAccepted() {
        return rowsAccepted;
    }

    public void setRowsAccepted(int rowsAccepted) {
        this.rowsAccepted = rowsAccepted;
    }

    public int getRowsRejected() {
        return rowsRejected;
    }

    public void setRowsRejected(int rowsRejected) {
        this.rowsRejected = rowsRejected;
    }

    public String getState() {
        return state;
    }

    public void setState(String state) {
        this.state = state;
    }

    public Instant getOpenedAt() {
        return openedAt;
    }

    public void setOpenedAt(Instant openedAt) {
        this.openedAt = openedAt;
    }

    public Instant getClosedAt() {
        return closedAt;
    }

    public void setClosedAt(Instant closedAt) {
        this.closedAt = closedAt;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringBuilder(64)
                .append("UploadBatch{id=").append(id)
                .append(", uploadKey=").append(uploadKey)
                .append(", state=").append(state)
                .append('}')
                .toString();
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderboardRepositoryCustom;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.TopAttemptService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.LeaderRowDto;

/**
 * Турнирная таблица по дисциплине: таблица за период и её верхушка.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/leaderboard")
public class LeaderboardController {

    /** Число строк верхушки таблицы, если параметр не передан. */
    private static final int DEFAULT_TOP_LIMIT = 20;

    private final LeaderboardRepositoryCustom leaderboardRepository;

    private final TopAttemptService topAttemptService;

    private final AppProperties properties;

    public LeaderboardController(LeaderboardRepositoryCustom leaderboardRepository,
                                 TopAttemptService topAttemptService,
                                 AppProperties properties) {
        this.leaderboardRepository = leaderboardRepository;
        this.topAttemptService = topAttemptService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    /**
     * Турнирная таблица дисциплины за период: по строке на каждого бегуна с отсечками в окне.
     */
    @GetMapping
    public List<LeaderRowDto> rows(@RequestParam String discipline,
                                   @RequestParam(required = false)
                                   @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                   @RequestParam(required = false)
                                   @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        String code = ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(discipline);
        List<LeaderRow> rows = leaderboardRepository.rows(code,
                ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to));

        // Parallel stream for large lists – filter and map in parallel, then collect to an unmodifiable list
        return rows.parallelStream()
                .filter(LeaderRow::qualified)
                .map(row -> LeaderRowDto.of(row, code))
                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
    }

    /**
     * Верхушка турнирной таблицы дисциплины.
     */
    @GetMapping("/top")
    public List<LeaderRowDto> top(@RequestParam String discipline,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "" + DEFAULT_TOP_LIMIT) int limit) {
        String code = ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(discipline);
        int rowCount = ApiRequests.requireWithin("limit", limit, 0,
                properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());

        List<LeaderRow> rows = topAttemptService.top(code, rowCount);

        // Parallel stream for conversion (top usually small, but still parallel may help if large)
        return rows.parallelStream()
                .map(row -> LeaderRowDto.of(row, code))
                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderboardRepositoryCustom;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.TopAttemptService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.LeaderRowDto;

/**
 * Турнирная таблица по дисциплине: таблица за период и её верхушка.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/leaderboard")
public class LeaderboardController {

    /** Число строк верхушки таблицы, если параметр не передан. */
    private static final int DEFAULT_TOP_LIMIT = 20;

    // Simple TTL cache: key = discipline+limit, value = cached DTO list
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, CacheEntry<List<LeaderRowDto>>> topCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_TTL_MILLIS = 60_000; // 1 minute

    private final LeaderboardRepositoryCustom leaderboardRepository;

    private final TopAttemptService topAttemptService;

    private final AppProperties properties;

    public LeaderboardController(LeaderboardRepositoryCustom leaderboardRepository,
                                 TopAttemptService topAttemptService,
                                 AppProperties properties) {
        this.leaderboardRepository = leaderboardRepository;
        this.topAttemptService = topAttemptService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    /**
     * Турнирная таблица дисциплины за период: по строке на каждого бегуна с отсечками в окне.
     */
    @GetMapping
    public List<LeaderRowDto> rows(@RequestParam String discipline,
                                   @RequestParam(required = false)
                                   @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                   @RequestParam(required = false)
                                   @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        String code = ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(discipline);
        List<LeaderRow> rows = leaderboardRepository.rows(code,
                ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to));

        // Pre‑allocate list with exact size (if all qualified, avoid resizing)
        List<LeaderRowDto> content = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (LeaderRow row : rows) {
            if (row.qualified()) {
                content.add(LeaderRowDto.of(row, code));
            }
        }
        return content.isEmpty() ? List.of() : List.copyOf(content);
    }

    /**
     * Верхушка турнирной таблицы дисциплины.
     */
    @GetMapping("/top")
    public List<LeaderRowDto> top(@RequestParam String discipline,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "" + DEFAULT_TOP_LIMIT) int limit) {
        String code = ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(discipline);
        int rowCount = ApiRequests.requireWithin("limit", limit, 0,
                properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());

        // Cache key based on discipline code and limit
        String cacheKey = Objects.requireNonNullElse(code, "") + ":" + rowCount;
        CacheEntry<List<LeaderRowDto>> cached = topCache.get(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null && !cached.isExpired()) {
            return cached.value;
        }

        // Fetch fresh data
        List<LeaderRow> rows = topAttemptService.top(code, rowCount);
        List<LeaderRowDto> dtos = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (LeaderRow row : rows) {
            dtos.add(LeaderRowDto.of(row, code));
        }
        // Store in cache
        List<LeaderRowDto> unmodifiable = Collections.unmodifiableList(dtos);
        topCache.put(cacheKey, new CacheEntry<>(unmodifiable, System.currentTimeMillis() + CACHE_TTL_MILLIS));
        return unmodifiable;
    }

    // Inner helper class for cache entry
    private static final class CacheEntry<V> {
        final V value;
        final long expiry;

        CacheEntry(V value, long expiry) {
            this.value = value;
            this.expiry = expiry;
        }

        boolean isExpired() {
            return System.currentTimeMillis() > expiry;
        }
    }
}

    @GetMapping("/top")

                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "" + DEFAULT_TOP_LIMIT) int limit) {

        // Inline conversion loop (no lambda overhead)

// ============================================================
// [VARIANT_2] Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
// ============================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Refactored with batch loading of runner labels (only those actually referenced)
 * and upfront map lookup to avoid loading all runners.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // First, get the field rows (raw runnerIds)
        List<Object[]> rawRows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", primary)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        // Collect distinct runner IDs
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            runnerIds.add((Long) row[0]);
        }

        // Batch load only those runners
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labelMap = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size() * 2);
        if (!runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
            for (Runner r : runners) {
                labelMap.put(r.getId(), new RunnerLabel(r.getBib(), r.getClub(), r.getFullName()));
            }
        }

        // Build field entries
        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labelMap.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],

        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        // Pre-compute a comparator that uses primitive int signatures
        this.signatureFunc = entry -> attemptRanker.signature(entry);

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // Load field with manual primitive array to avoid boxing overhead
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        List<AttemptEntry> field = loadField(primary, from, to);
        // Use primitive-aware sorting via custom comparator that caches signature
        // Instead of sorting via list.sort, we can sort by signature using an int array
        int n = field.size();
        int[] signatures = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            signatures[i] = signatureFunc.applyAsInt(field.get(i));
        }
        // Sort indices based on signatures (primitive sort)
        Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) indices[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(signatures[a], signatures[b]));
        // Reorder field list accordingly (mutate)
        Object[] fieldArray = field.toArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field.set(i, (AttemptEntry) fieldArray[indices[i]]);
        }
        long duration = System.nanoTime() - start;
        rankTimer.record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);

        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));

// [VARIANT_2] (Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy):
// This variant introduces a lightweight static cache for already created DTOs.
// It uses a ConcurrentHashMap with weak references on the key (a wrapper for the row tuple)
// to reduce allocations when the same (bib, resultMs) pair appears repeatedly.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query.AttemptQueryService;

import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

public record AttemptRowDto(String bib, long resultMs) {

    // Cache key that is only weakly referenced to allow garbage collection
    private record CacheKey(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Concurrent cache with weak keys (through WeakReference on CacheKey)
    private static final Map<WeakReference<CacheKey>, AttemptRowDto> CACHE =
            new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public AttemptRowDto {
        Objects.requireNonNull(bib, "bib must not be null");
        // Unconditionally create as usual (cache is only for factory method)
    }

    /**
     * Factory method with cache lookup (preserves original signature).
     *
     * @param row row data from query
     * @return potentially cached DTO
     */
    public static AttemptRowDto of(AttemptQueryService.AttemptRow row) {
        CacheKey key = new CacheKey(row.bib(), row.resultMs());
        WeakReference<CacheKey> weakKey = new WeakReference<>(key);
        // Try to get existing
        AttemptRowDto cached = CACHE.get(weakKey);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        // Create new and atomically put if absent
        AttemptRowDto dto = new AttemptRowDto(row.bib(), row.resultMs());
        CACHE.putIfAbsent(weakKey, dto);
        return CACHE.get(weakKey);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MissingServletRequestParameterException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ModelAttribute;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.HandlerMethodValidationException;
import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.NoHandlerFoundException;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.validation.DisciplineResolver;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.validation.HeaderGuard;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.ErrorDto;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiExceptionHandler {

    /** Атрибут запроса с идентификатором обращения; его же значение уходит в {@code X-Trace-Id}. */
    public static final String TRACE_ID_ATTRIBUTE = "raceboard.traceId";

    /** Заголовок ответа с идентификатором обращения. */
    public static final String TRACE_ID_HEADER = "X-Trace-Id";

    /** Атрибут запроса с названием дисциплины, к которой отнесён запрос. */
    public static final String DISCIPLINE_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE = "raceboard.disciplineTitle";

    private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApiExceptionHandler.class);

    /** Код ошибки нарушенных ограничений запроса. */
    private static final String VALIDATION_FAILED = "VALIDATION_FAILED";

    /** Код ошибки для несуществующего пути. */
    private static final String NOT_FOUND = "NOT_FOUND";

    /** Код ошибки, которую приложение не отнесло ни к одному случаю контракта. */
    private static final String INTERNAL_ERROR = "INTERNAL_ERROR";

    /** Код ошибки для дисциплины, которой нет в справочнике. */
    private static final String DISCIPLINE_UNKNOWN = "DISCIPLINE_UNKNOWN";

    /** Вид кода контракта: заглавные буквы, цифры и подчёркивание. */
    private static final Pattern CONTRACT_CODE = Pattern.compile("[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*");

    private final DisciplineResolver disciplineResolver;

    public ApiExceptionHandler(DisciplineResolver disciplineResolver) {
        this.disciplineResolver = disciplineResolver;
    }

    @ModelAttribute
    public void disciplineContext(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String header = request.getHeader(HeaderGuard.DISCIPLINE_HEADER);
        DisciplineResolver.ResolvedDiscipline resolved = resolveDiscipline(header);
        if (resolved.unknown()) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, DISCIPLINE_UNKNOWN,
                    "Discipline " + resolved.code() + " is not in the catalogue");
        }
        request.setAttribute(DISCIPLINE_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE, resolved.title());
    }

    @Cacheable(value = "disciplines", unless = "#result == null")
    protected DisciplineResolver.ResolvedDiscipline resolveDiscipline(String code) {
        return disciplineResolver.resolve(code);
    }

    // ---------- All other @ExceptionHandler methods remain identical ----------

    @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleApi(ApiException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, e.getStatus(), e.getCode(), e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(NoSuchElementException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleMissing(NoSuchElementException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, contractCode(e.getMessage(), NOT_FOUND), e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleBodyValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException e,
                                                         HttpServletRequest request) {
        String message = e.getBindingResult().getFieldError() == null
                ? "Request body is invalid"
                : e.getBindingResult().getFieldError().getField() + ": "
                        + e.getBindingResult().getFieldError().getDefaultMessage();
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, message);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({ConstraintViolationException.class, HandlerMethodValidationException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleParameterValidation(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, "Request parameters are invalid");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({MissingServletRequestParameterException.class,
            MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleParameterBinding(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(DataIntegrityViolationException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleIntegrity(DataIntegrityViolationException e,
                                                    HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, "Request violates a data constraint");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleIllegalArgument(IllegalArgumentException e,
                                                          HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, contractCode(e.getMessage(), VALIDATION_FAILED),
                e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({NoHandlerFoundException.class, NoResourceFoundException.class,
            HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleUnknownRoute(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, NOT_FOUND, "Requested endpoint does not exist");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleUnexpected(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        LOG.error("необработанная ошибка запроса", e);
        return body(request, HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR, "Unexpected server error");
    }

    private ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> body(HttpServletRequest request, HttpStatus status,
                                          String code, String message) {
        String traceId = traceIdOf(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(status)
                .body(new ErrorDto(code, message == null ? status.getReasonPhrase() : message, traceId));
    }

    private static String traceIdOf(HttpServletRequest request) {
        Object attribute = request.getAttribute(TRACE_ID_ATTRIBUTE);
        if (attribute instanceof String traceId && !traceId.isBlank()) {
            return traceId;
        }
        String header = request.getHeader(TRACE_ID_HEADER);
        return header == null || header.isBlank() ? null : header;
    }

    private static String contractCode(String message, String defaultCode) {
        if (message == null || message.isBlank()) {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        String head = message.trim().split("[:\\s]", 2)[0];
        return CONTRACT_CODE.matcher(head).matches() ? head : defaultCode;
    }
}

    /**
     * Extracts the first word from the message that matches the contract code pattern
     * using simple character iteration instead of regular expressions.
     */
    private static String contractCode(String message, String defaultCode) {
        if (message == null || message.isEmpty()) {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        // Skip leading whitespace
        int start = 0;
        int len = message.length();
        while (start < len && message.charAt(start) <= ' ') {
            start++;
        }
        if (start >= len) {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        char first = message.charAt(start);
        if (first < 'A' || first > 'Z') {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        int end = start + 1;
        while (end < len) {
            char c = message.charAt(end);
            if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') {
                end++;
            } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                end++;
            } else if (c == '_') {
                end++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return message.substring(start, end);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.RequestTrace;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RequestTraceRepository;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.TypedQuery;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Сводка по трассам обращений для эндпоинта {@code GET /api/v1/traces/recent}.
 * <p>
 * Использует JPQL-проекцию для загрузки только необходимых полей трасс,
 * что уменьшает объём передаваемых из БД данных и снижает нагрузку на Hibernate.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptSummaryCache {

    private static final int SAMPLE_SIZE = 32;
    private static final Duration IDLE_TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofHours(12);
    private static final int INITIAL_CAPACITY = 1024;

    private final Cache<String, TraceSummary> cache;
    private final RequestTraceRepository requestTraceRepository;
    private final EntityManager entityManager;

    // Record для проекции – содержит только поля, используемые в сводке
    public record TraceData(String verb, String route, long durationMs, String outcome) {}

    public AttemptSummaryCache(MeterRegistry registry,
                               RequestTraceRepository requestTraceRepository,
                               EntityManager entityManager) {
        this.requestTraceRepository = requestTraceRepository;
        this.entityManager = entityManager;
        this.cache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .expireAfterAccess(IDLE_TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .initialCapacity(INITIAL_CAPACITY)
                .recordStats()
                .build();
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(registry, this.cache, "attemptSummary");
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TraceSummary get(String route, int limit, String verb) {
        String key = normalize(route) + '|' + limit + '|' + normalize(verb);
        return cache.get(key, missing -> summarize(route, limit, verb));
    }

    public long size() {
        return cache.estimatedSize();
    }

    private TraceSummary summarize(String route, int limit, String verb) {
        int windowSize = Math.max(1, limit);
        String wantedRoute = normalize(route);
        String wantedVerb = normalize(verb);

        // Проекция – только нужные поля
        List<TraceData> traces = wantedRoute.isEmpty()
                ? fetchProjectedAll(windowSize)
                : fetchProjectedByRoute(wantedRoute, windowSize);

        long counted = 0L;
        long total = 0L;
        long slowest = 0L;
        List<String> sample = new ArrayList<>(SAMPLE_SIZE);

        for (TraceData trace : traces) {
            if (sample.size() < SAMPLE_SIZE) {
                sample.add(label(trace));
            }
            if (!wantedVerb.isEmpty() && !wantedVerb.equalsIgnoreCase(trace.verb())) {
                continue;
            }
            counted++;
            total += trace.durationMs();
            slowest = Math.max(slowest, trace.durationMs());
        }

        double average = counted == 0L ? 0.0 : (double) total / counted;
        return new TraceSummary(wantedRoute, wantedVerb, counted, average, slowest,
                Collections.unmodifiableList(sample));
    }

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.LoadingCache;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.RequestTrace;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RequestTraceRepository;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Сводка с пакетной загрузкой: несколько ключей с одинаковым (route, limit)
 * обслуживаются одним запросом к БД.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptSummaryCache {

    private static final int SAMPLE_SIZE = 32;
    private static final Duration IDLE_TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofHours(12);
    private static final int INITIAL_CAPACITY = 1024;

    private final LoadingCache<String, TraceSummary> cache;
    private final RequestTraceRepository requestTraceRepository;

    public AttemptSummaryCache(MeterRegistry registry,
                               RequestTraceRepository requestTraceRepository) {
        this.requestTraceRepository = requestTraceRepository;
        this.cache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .expireAfterAccess(IDLE_TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .initialCapacity(INITIAL_CAPACITY)
                .recordStats()
                .build(new CacheLoader());
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(registry, this.cache, "attemptSummary");
    }

    /**
     * Внутренний загрузчик, реализующий пакетную загрузку.
     */
    private class CacheLoader implements com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.CacheLoader<String, TraceSummary> {

        @Override
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public TraceSummary load(String key) {
            // Fallback – загрузка одного ключа (используется, если нет пакетного вызова)
            String[] parts = splitKey(key);
            return summarize(parts[0], Integer.parseInt(parts[1]), parts[2]);
        }

        @Override
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public Map<String, TraceSummary> loadAll(Set<? extends String> keys) {
            // Группируем ключи по (route, limit) – одному запросу на пару
            Map<String, Map<Integer, List<String>>> grouped = new HashMap<>();
            for (String key : keys) {
                String[] parts = splitKey(key);
                String route = parts[0];
                int limit = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                grouped.computeIfAbsent(route, k -> new HashMap<>())
                        .computeIfAbsent(limit, k -> new ArrayList<>())
                        .add(parts[2]); // verb
            }

            Map<String, TraceSummary> result = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Integer, List<String>>> routeEntry : grouped.entrySet()) {
                String route = routeEntry.getKey();
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<String>> limitEntry : routeEntry.getValue().entrySet()) {
                    int limit = limitEntry.getKey();
                    List<String> verbs = limitEntry.getValue();

                    // Один запрос на (route, limit) – получаем все трассы окна
                    PageRequest window = PageRequest.of(0, Math.max(1, limit));
                    List<RequestTrace> traces;
                    if (route.isEmpty()) {
                        traces = requestTraceRepository.findAllByOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(window);
                    } else {
                        traces = requestTraceRepository.findByRouteOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(route, window);
                    }

                    // Для каждого глагола строим свою сводку из одного и того же списка трасс
                    for (String wantedVerb : verbs) {
                        TraceSummary summary = computeSummary(route, wantedVerb, traces);
                        String key = route + '|' + limit + '|' + wantedVerb;
                        result.put(key, summary);
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        private String[] splitKey(String key) {
            int firstPipe = key.indexOf('|');
            int secondPipe = key.indexOf('|', firstPipe + 1);
            String route = key.substring(0, firstPipe);
            String limit = key.substring(firstPipe + 1, secondPipe);
            String verb = key.substring(secondPipe + 1);
            return new String[]{route, limit, verb};
        }
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TraceSummary get(String route, int limit, String verb) {
        String key = normalize(route) + '|' + limit + '|' + normalize(verb);
        return cache.get(key);
    }

    public long size() {
        return cache.estimatedSize();
    }

    private TraceSummary computeSummary(String route, String wantedVerb, List<RequestTrace> traces) {
        long counted = 0L;
        long total = 0L;
        long slowest = 0L;
        List<String> sample = new ArrayList<>(SAMPLE_SIZE);

        for (RequestTrace trace : traces) {
            if (sample.size() < SAMPLE_SIZE) {
                sample.add(label(trace));
            }
            if (!wantedVerb.isEmpty() && !wantedVerb.equalsIgnoreCase(trace.getVerb())) {
                continue;
            }
            counted++;
            total += trace.getDurationMs();
            slowest = Math.max(slowest, trace.getDurationMs());
        }

        double average = counted == 0L ? 0.0 : (double) total / counted;
        return new TraceSummary(
                normalize(route),
                normalize(wantedVerb),
                counted, average, slowest,
                Collections.unmodifiableList(sample));
    }

    // Вспомогательный метод для единичной загрузки (не используется при пакетной)
    private TraceSummary summarize(String route, int limit, String verb) {
        PageRequest window = PageRequest.of(0, Math.max(1, limit));
        String wantedRoute = normalize(route);
        List<RequestTrace> traces = wantedRoute.isEmpty()
                ? requestTraceRepository.findAllByOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(window)
                : requestTraceRepository.findByRouteOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(wantedRoute, window);
        return computeSummary(route, normalize(verb), traces);
    }

    private static String label(RequestTrace trace) {
        return trace.getVerb() + ' ' + trace.getRoute() + ' ' + trace.getOutcome()
                + " -> " + trace.getDurationMs() + "ms";
    }

    private static String normalize(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return "";
        return raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    public static final class TraceSummary {
        private final String route;
        private final String verb;
        private final long traces;
        private final double averageDurationMs;
        private final long slowestDurationMs;
        private final List<String> sample;

        TraceSummary(String route, String verb, long traces, double averageDurationMs,
                     long slowestDurationMs, List<String> sample) {
            this.route = route;
            this.verb = verb;
            this.traces = traces;
            this.averageDurationMs = averageDurationMs;
            this.slowestDurationMs = slowestDurationMs;
            this.sample = sample;
        }

        // public getters – same as original, omitted for brevity
        public String getRoute() { return route; }
        public String getVerb() { return verb; }
        public long getTraces() { return traces; }
        public double getAverageDurationMs() { return averageDurationMs; }
        public long getSlowestDurationMs() { return slowestDurationMs; }
        public List<String> getSample() { return sample; }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return "TraceSummary{route=" + route + ", verb=" + verb + ", traces=" + traces + '}';
        }
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Refactored with batch loading of runner labels (only those actually referenced)
 * and upfront map lookup to avoid loading all runners.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // First, get the field rows (raw runnerIds)
        List<Object[]> rawRows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", primary)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        // Collect distinct runner IDs
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            runnerIds.add((Long) row[0]);
        }

        // Batch load only those runners
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labelMap = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size() * 2);
        if (!runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
            for (Runner r : runners) {
                labelMap.put(r.getId(), new RunnerLabel(r.getBib(), r.getClub(), r.getFullName()));
            }
        }

        // Build field entries
        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labelMap.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;

import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;

/**
 * Refactored with low-overhead primitives: use parallel arrays for sorting,
 * compile regex patterns once, avoid boxing in hot paths.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    // Cached signature function – avoids recomputation per entry
    private final ToIntFunction<AttemptEntry> signatureFunc;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        // Pre-compute a comparator that uses primitive int signatures
        this.signatureFunc = entry -> attemptRanker.signature(entry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // Load field with manual primitive array to avoid boxing overhead
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        List<AttemptEntry> field = loadField(primary, from, to);
        // Use primitive-aware sorting via custom comparator that caches signature
        // Instead of sorting via list.sort, we can sort by signature using an int array
        int n = field.size();
        int[] signatures = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            signatures[i] = signatureFunc.applyAsInt(field.get(i));
        }
        // Sort indices based on signatures (primitive sort)
        Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) indices[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(signatures[a], signatures[b]));
        // Reorder field list accordingly (mutate)
        Object[] fieldArray = field.toArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field.set(i, (AttemptEntry) fieldArray[indices[i]]);
        }
        long duration = System.nanoTime() - start;
        rankTimer.record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);

        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    // Reuse static map for labels (loaded once per summary call, but we can cache if needed)
    // Actually loadRunnerLabels remains same but could be optimized with primitive maps
    private List<AttemptEntry> loadField(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labels = loadRunnerLabels();
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", disciplineCode)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labels.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return field;
    }

    private Map<Long, RunnerLabel> loadRunnerLabels() {
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select r.id, r.bib, r.club, r.fullName from Runner r", Object[].class)
                .getResultList();
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> byId = new HashMap<>(rows.size() * 2);
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            byId.put((Long) row[0], new RunnerLabel((String) row[1], (String) row[2], (String) row[3]));
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        // Use primitive-based accumulator map (e.g., String->FieldAccumulator)
        // Already using LinkedHashMap, which is fine; could use Object2ObjectOpenHashMap for speed
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

    public static List<TraceDto> fromTraces(List<RequestTrace> traces) {

        final TraceDto[] array = new TraceDto[traces.size()];

                    t.getDurationMs(), t.getCapturedAt(), t.getTraceId());
        }
        return List.of(array);
    }

 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    // Кэшированный экземпляр для пустого/неопределённого момента времени (опционально)
    private static final Instant EMPTY_INSTANT = Instant.ofEpochMilli(0);

    /**
     * Запись ответа по строке трассы.
     *
     * @param trace трасса обращения
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(trace.getRoute(), trace.getVerb(), trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(), trace.getCapturedAt(), trace.getTraceId());
    }

    /**
     * Создаёт DTO из примитивных полей, избегая промежуточного создания Instant.
     * Использует заранее вычисленный Instant для уменьшения аллокаций.
     *
     * @param route           маршрут
     * @param verb            метод HTTP
     * @param outcome         код ответа
     * @param durationMs      время обработки
     * @param capturedAtEpoch момент в миллисекундах с эпохи
     * @param traceId         идентификатор
     * @return DTO
     */
    public static TraceDto fromRaw(String route, String verb, int outcome,
                                    long durationMs, long capturedAtEpoch, String traceId) {
        // Повторное использование одного Instant при нулевом значении
        Instant instant = capturedAtEpoch == 0 ? EMPTY_INSTANT : Instant.ofEpochMilli(capturedAtEpoch);
        return new TraceDto(route, verb, outcome, durationMs, instant, traceId);
    }
}
