     *  Использует кэш, чтобы избежать повторного обращения к файловой системе. */
    private void requireSource(String source) {
        // Быстрый путь – результат уже в кэше
        Boolean cached = sourceCache.get(source);
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(cached)) return;
        if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(cached)) throw sourceNotFound(source);

        // Выполняем дорогую проверку
        Path path;
        try {
            path = uploadReader.resolve(source);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException rejected) {
            sourceCache.put(source, Boolean.FALSE);
            throw sourceNotFound(source);
        }
        boolean exists = Files.isRegularFile(path);
        sourceCache.put(source, exists);
        if (!exists) {
            throw sourceNotFound(source);
        }
    }

    private static ApiException sourceNotFound(String source) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "SOURCE_NOT_FOUND",
                "Source file " + source + " not found");
    }

// [VARIANT_2] Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
// Pre‑computes frequently used values (hash codes, split indices) into static arrays.
// Inlines common formula evaluations to avoid repeated method calls.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.seed;

import java.time.*;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.Locale;

public final class SeedFormulas {

    private static final int[] DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH;
    private static final int[] STATUS_HASH;
    private static final int[] CLUB_HASH;

    static {
        DISCIPLINE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINES[i].hashCode();
        }
        DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINE_TITLES[i].hashCode();
        }
        STATUS_HASH = new int[STATUSES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < STATUSES.length; i++) {
            STATUS_HASH[i] = STATUSES[i].hashCode();
        }
        CLUB_HASH = new int[CLUBS.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < CLUBS.length; i++) {
            CLUB_HASH[i] = CLUBS[i].hashCode();
        }
    }

    // ── Optimized checksum ─────────────────────────────────────────
    public static long checksum(int runners, int activeRunners, int attemptsPerRunner,
                                int splitTimes, int disciplines, int uploadRows) {
        long acc = SEED;
        acc = fold(acc, runners);
        acc = fold(acc, activeRunners);
        acc = fold(acc, attemptsPerRunner);
        acc = fold(acc, splitTimes);
        acc = fold(acc, disciplines);
        acc = fold(acc, uploadRows);

        // Pre‑compute runner‑related values in one pass (batching)
        for (int i = 0; i < runners; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, RUNNER_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, bib(i).hashCode());          // could also precompute bib hash
            acc = fold(acc, registeredOn(i).toEpochDay());
            acc = fold(acc, CLUB_HASH[(int) Math.floorMod(mix(i, 31), CLUBS.length)]);
            acc = fold(acc, active(i, activeRunners) ? 1L : 0L);
        }

        // Attempts: use pre‑computed status hash and discipline hash
        int attempts = runners * attemptsPerRunner;
        for (int i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, ATTEMPT_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, resultMs(i));
            acc = fold(acc, timestampEpochSecond(i));
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[disciplineIndex(i)]);
            acc = fold(acc, STATUS_HASH[(int) Math.floorMod(mix(i, 37), STATUSES.length)]);
        }

        // Splits: similar approach
        for (int i = 0; i < splitTimes; i++) {
            long idx = SPLIT_INDEX_OFFSET + i;
            acc = fold(acc, SPLIT_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, splitRunnerIndex(i, runners));
            acc = fold(acc, elapsedMs(idx));
            acc = fold(acc, timestampEpochSecond(idx));
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[disciplineIndex(idx)]);
            acc = fold(acc, lap(idx));
        }

        // Disciplines: use pre‑hashed arrays
        int lim = Math.min(disciplines, DISCIPLINES.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[i]);
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH[i]);
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_LAPS[i]);
        }
        return acc;
    }

    // ... (all other methods remain the same, except that statusCode and disciplineCode can be used as before)
}

/**
 * Отсечка на контрольной точке: сколько прошло от старта к моменту прохождения круга.
 * <p>
 * Оптимизация:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>equals/hashCode основаны на бизнес-ключе (runnerId, disciplineCode, lap, checkpointCode),
 *       что позволяет корректно использовать сущности в {@code Set} до персиста и избежать N+1 запросов для проверки дубликатов.</li>
 *   <li>Генерация ID изменена на SEQUENCE с allocationSize=50 для эффективной пакетной вставки (INSERT batching).</li>
 *   <li>Добавлен статический метод {@link #batchFromRecords(List, Function)} для массового создания SplitTime из сырых записей,
 *       использующий мапу для объединения дубликатов без обращения к БД.</li>
 * </ul>
 * Все публичные методы исходного класса сохранены.
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "split_time",
        indexes = @Index(name = "ix_split_disc_lap", columnList = "discipline_code, lap")
)
@SequenceGenerator(name = "split_seq", sequenceName = "split_time_id_seq", allocationSize = 50)
public class SplitTime {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.SEQUENCE, generator = "split_seq")
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "runner_id", nullable = false)
    private Long runnerId;

    @Column(name = "discipline_code", nullable = false, length = 16)
    private String disciplineCode;

    @Column(name = "lap", nullable = false)
    private int lap;

    /** Время от старта до контрольной точки в миллисекундах. */
    @Column(name = "elapsed_ms", nullable = false)
    private long elapsedMs;

    @Column(name = "recorded_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant recordedAt;

    @Column(name = "checkpoint_code", length = 24)
    private String checkpointCode;

    public SplitTime() {
    }

    /**
     * Создаёт {@code Map<BusinessKey, SplitTime>} из списка исходных записей.
     * Если ключ дублируется, оставляется запись с минимальным elapsedMs.
     * @param records      список сырых данных (например, строк файла)
     * @param converter    функция преобразования записи в SplitTime (без id)
     * @return мапа, готовая для {@code repository.saveAll(map.values())}
     */
    public static Map<BusinessKey, SplitTime> batchFromRecords(
            List<Object[]> records,
            Function<Object[], SplitTime> converter) {
        return records.stream()
                .map(converter)
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                        st -> new BusinessKey(st.runnerId, st.disciplineCode, st.lap, st.checkpointCode),
                        Function.identity(),
                        (a, b) -> a.elapsedMs <= b.elapsedMs ? a : b,
                        LinkedHashMap::new
                ));
    }

    /**
     * Внутренний класс бизнес-ключа для быстрого хеш-поиска.
     */
    public record BusinessKey(Long runnerId, String disciplineCode, int lap, String checkpointCode) {}

        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public Long getRunnerId() {
        return runnerId;
    }

    public void setRunnerId(Long runnerId) {
        this.runnerId = runnerId;
    }

    public String getDisciplineCode() {
        return disciplineCode;
    }

    public void setDisciplineCode(String disciplineCode) {
        this.disciplineCode = disciplineCode;
    }

    public int getLap() {
        return lap;
    }

    public void setLap(int lap) {
        this.lap = lap;
    }

    public long getElapsedMs() {
        return elapsedMs;
    }

    public void setElapsedMs(long elapsedMs) {
        this.elapsedMs = elapsedMs;
    }

    public Instant getRecordedAt() {
        return recordedAt;
    }

    public void setRecordedAt(Instant recordedAt) {
        this.recordedAt = recordedAt;
    }

    public String getCheckpointCode() {
        return checkpointCode;
    }

    public void setCheckpointCode(String checkpointCode) {
        this.checkpointCode = checkpointCode;
    }

    /** Равенство по бизнес-ключу: бегун + дисциплина + круг + точка. */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other) {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof SplitTime that)) return false;
        return Objects.equals(runnerId, that.runnerId)
                && Objects.equals(disciplineCode, that.disciplineCode)
                && lap == that.lap
                && Objects.equals(checkpointCode, that.checkpointCode);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(runnerId, disciplineCode, lap, checkpointCode);
    }

    public String toString() {
        return "SplitTime{id=" + id + ", lap=" + lap + "}";

/**
 * Запись справочника дисциплин.
 * Оптимизировано для массового преобразования: статический метод ofBatch() использует
 * предварительно выделенный список и избегает лишнего роста внутреннего массива.
 *
 * @param code      код дисциплины
 * @param title     отображаемое название
 * @param unitLabel единица, в которой результат показывается пользователю
 * @param lapCount  число контрольных отсечек на дистанции
 */
public record DisciplineDto(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {

     * Преобразует коллекцию записей справочника в список DTO.
     *
     * @param entries коллекция записей справочника (может быть null)
     * @return список DTO, не null
     */
    public static List<DisciplineDto> ofBatch(Collection<DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry> entries) {
        if (entries == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int size = entries.size();
        List<DisciplineDto> result = new ArrayList<>(size);
        for (DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry : entries) {
            result.add(new DisciplineDto(entry.code(), entry.title(), entry.unitLabel(), entry.lapCount()));
        }
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Запись ответа по записи справочника.
     *
     * @param entry запись справочника
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static DisciplineDto of(DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry) {
        return new DisciplineDto(entry.code(), entry.title(), entry.unitLabel(), entry.lapCount());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache.DisciplineCatalogCache;

/**
 * Запись справочника дисциплин.
 * Использует String.intern() для полей, чтобы уменьшить дублирование строк
 * в куче при условии, что CatalogEntry возвращает одинаковые строковые объекты.
 *
 * @param code      код дисциплины (interned)
 * @param title     отображаемое название (interned)
 * @param unitLabel единица, в которой результат показывается пользователю (interned)
 * @param lapCount  число контрольных отсечек на дистанции
 */
public record DisciplineDto(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {

    /**
     * Запись ответа по записи справочника.
     * Поля код, название и единица измерения интернируются,
     * что позволяет сократить потребление памяти при большом количестве повторяющихся значений.
     *
     * @param entry запись справочника
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static DisciplineDto of(DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry) {
        return new DisciplineDto(
                entry.code().intern(),
                entry.title().intern(),
                entry.unitLabel().intern(),
                entry.lapCount()
        );
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Refactored with batch loading of runner labels (only those actually referenced)
 * and upfront map lookup to avoid loading all runners.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // First, get the field rows (raw runnerIds)
        List<Object[]> rawRows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", primary)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        // Collect distinct runner IDs
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            runnerIds.add((Long) row[0]);
        }

        // Batch load only those runners
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labelMap = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size() * 2);
        if (!runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
            for (Runner r : runners) {
                labelMap.put(r.getId(), new RunnerLabel(r.getBib(), r.getClub(), r.getFullName()));
            }
        }

        // Build field entries
        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labelMap.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

// ============================================================
// [VARIANT_3] Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;

/**
 * Refactored with low-overhead primitives: use parallel arrays for sorting,
 * compile regex patterns once, avoid boxing in hot paths.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    // Cached signature function – avoids recomputation per entry
    private final ToIntFunction<AttemptEntry> signatureFunc;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        // Pre-compute a comparator that uses primitive int signatures
        this.signatureFunc = entry -> attemptRanker.signature(entry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // Load field with manual primitive array to avoid boxing overhead
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        List<AttemptEntry> field = loadField(primary, from, to);
        // Use primitive-aware sorting via custom comparator that caches signature
        // Instead of sorting via list.sort, we can sort by signature using an int array
        int n = field.size();
        int[] signatures = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            signatures[i] = signatureFunc.applyAsInt(field.get(i));
        }
        // Sort indices based on signatures (primitive sort)
        Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) indices[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(signatures[a], signatures[b]));
        // Reorder field list accordingly (mutate)
        Object[] fieldArray = field.toArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field.set(i, (AttemptEntry) fieldArray[indices[i]]);
        }
        long duration = System.nanoTime() - start;
        rankTimer.record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);

        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    // Reuse static map for labels (loaded once per summary call, but we can cache if needed)
    // Actually loadRunnerLabels remains same but could be optimized with primitive maps
    private List<AttemptEntry> loadField(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labels = loadRunnerLabels();
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", disciplineCode)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labels.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return field;
    }

    private Map<Long, RunnerLabel> loadRunnerLabels() {
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select r.id, r.bib, r.club, r.fullName from Runner r", Object[].class)
                .getResultList();
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> byId = new HashMap<>(rows.size() * 2);
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            byId.put((Long) row[0], new RunnerLabel((String) row[1], (String) row[2], (String) row[3]));
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        // Use primitive-based accumulator map (e.g., String->FieldAccumulator)
        // Already using LinkedHashMap, which is fine; could use Object2ObjectOpenHashMap for speed
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache.DisciplineCatalogCache;

/**
 * Запись справочника дисциплин.
 * Использует String.intern() для полей, чтобы уменьшить дублирование строк
 * в куче при условии, что CatalogEntry возвращает одинаковые строковые объекты.
 *
 * @param code      код дисциплины (interned)
 * @param title     отображаемое название (interned)
 * @param unitLabel единица, в которой результат показывается пользователю (interned)
 * @param lapCount  число контрольных отсечек на дистанции
 */
public record DisciplineDto(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {

    /**
     * Запись ответа по записи справочника.
     * Поля код, название и единица измерения интернируются,
     * что позволяет сократить потребление памяти при большом количестве повторяющихся значений.
     *
     * @param entry запись справочника
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static DisciplineDto of(DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry) {
        return new DisciplineDto(
                entry.code().intern(),
                entry.title().intern(),
                entry.unitLabel().intern(),
                entry.lapCount()
        );
    }
}

 * Variant 2: Добавлен статический метод для пакетной загрузки строк с группировкой по (disciplineCode, heldOn),
 * а также возможность создавать индексные карты для избежания вложенных запросов.
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "leaderboard_row",
        indexes = {
                @Index(name = "ix_leader_disc_held", columnList = "discipline_code, held_on"),
                @Index(name = "ix_leader_runner", columnList = "runner_id")        // дополнительный индекс для быстрых lookup по бегуну
        }
)
public class LeaderboardRow {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "runner_id", nullable = false)
    private long runnerId;

    @Column(name = "discipline_code", nullable = false, length = 16)
    private String disciplineCode;

    @Column(name = "held_on", nullable = false)
    private LocalDate heldOn;

    @Column(name = "attempts")
    private long attempts;

    @Column(name = "best_result_ms")
    private long bestResultMs;

    @Column(name = "median_result_ms")
    private long medianResultMs;

    // ---- Вспомогательные статические методы для пакетной обработки ----

    /**
     * Строит карту "ключ(disc, date) -> список строк" для быстрой in-memory группировки.
     * Полезно при обработке большого количества строк, полученных одним запросом.
     */
    public static Map<String, Map<LocalDate, List<LeaderboardRow>>> buildIndex(List<LeaderboardRow> rows) {
        Map<String, Map<LocalDate, List<LeaderboardRow>>> idx = new HashMap<>();
        for (LeaderboardRow row : rows) {
            idx.computeIfAbsent(row.disciplineCode, k -> new HashMap<>())
               .computeIfAbsent(row.heldOn, k -> new ArrayList<>())
               .add(row);
        }
        return idx;
    }

    /**
     * Извлекает уникальные значения полей, пригодные для IN-запросов.
     */
    public static List<Long> extractRunnerIds(List<LeaderboardRow> rows) {
        return rows.stream()
                   .map(LeaderboardRow::getRunnerId)
                   .distinct()
                   .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    // ---- Конструкторы и мутаторы ----

    public LeaderboardRow() {
    }

    // геттеры / сеттеры (идентично исходному, но с примитивным long для runnerId)

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public long getRunnerId() {
        return runnerId;
    }

    public void setRunnerId(long runnerId) {
        this.runnerId = runnerId;
    }

    public String getDisciplineCode() {
        return disciplineCode;
    }

    public void setDisciplineCode(String disciplineCode) {
        this.disciplineCode = disciplineCode;
    }

    public LocalDate getHeldOn() {
        return heldOn;
    }

    public void setHeldOn(LocalDate heldOn) {
        this.heldOn = heldOn;
    }

    public long getAttempts() {
        return attempts;
    }

    public void setAttempts(long attempts) {
        this.attempts = attempts;
    }

    public long getBestResultMs() {
        return bestResultMs;
    }

    public void setBestResultMs(long bestResultMs) {
        this.bestResultMs = bestResultMs;
    }

    public long getMedianResultMs() {
        return medianResultMs;
    }

    public void setMedianResultMs(long medianResultMs) {
        this.medianResultMs = medianResultMs;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        LeaderboardRow that = (LeaderboardRow) o;
        return runnerId == that.runnerId &&
               attempts == that.attempts &&
               bestResultMs == that.bestResultMs &&
               medianResultMs == that.medianResultMs &&
               Objects.equals(id, that.id) &&
               Objects.equals(disciplineCode, that.disciplineCode) &&
               Objects.equals(heldOn, that.heldOn);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(id, runnerId, disciplineCode, heldOn, attempts, bestResultMs, medianResultMs);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "LeaderboardRow{id=" + id + ", runnerId=" + runnerId + ", heldOn=" + heldOn + "}";
    }
}

// Pre‑computes frequently used values (hash codes, split indices) into static arrays.
// Inlines common formula evaluations to avoid repeated method calls.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.seed;

import java.time.*;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.Locale;

public final class SeedFormulas {

    // ... (unchanged constants: SEED, BASE, CLUBS, etc.)

    // ── Pre‑computed hash codes for constant strings ──────────────
    private static final int[] DISCIPLINE_HASH;
    private static final int[] DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH;
    private static final int[] STATUS_HASH;
    private static final int[] CLUB_HASH;

    static {
        DISCIPLINE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINES[i].hashCode();
        }
        DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINE_TITLES[i].hashCode();
        }
        STATUS_HASH = new int[STATUSES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < STATUSES.length; i++) {
            STATUS_HASH[i] = STATUSES[i].hashCode();
        }
        CLUB_HASH = new int[CLUBS.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < CLUBS.length; i++) {
            CLUB_HASH[i] = CLUBS[i].hashCode();
        }

// ====================================================================
// [VARIANT_2] – Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy

//   findAllById with a projection, minimizing object creation.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        // Fetch only necessary fields via a projection (interface)
        Page<AttemptProjection> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqualProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOfProjected(page.getContent());
        return page.map(proj -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(proj.getRunnerId()), proj.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOfProjected(List<AttemptProjection> projections) {
        if (projections.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>(projections.size());
        for (AttemptProjection p : projections) {
            Long rid = p.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                ids.add(rid);
            }
        }
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        // Use findAllById with projection to get only id and bib
        List<BibProjection> bibProjections = runnerRepository.findBibByIds(ids);
        Map<Long, String> byId = new HashMap<>(bibProjections.size() * 2);
        for (BibProjection bp : bibProjections) {
            byId.put(bp.getId(), bp.getBib());
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Repository projections (must be defined in respective repositories)
    public interface AttemptProjection {
        Long getRunnerId();
        long getResultMs();
    }
    public interface BibProjection {
        Long getId();
        String getBib();
    }
}

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)

        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        Page<Attempt> page = maxResultMs == null

                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqual(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        return page.map(attempt -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(attempt.getRunnerId()), attempt.getResultMs()));

    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {

    private LongStringMap bibsOf(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        if (attempts.isEmpty()) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Collect unique runner IDs into a primitive array
        long[] rawIds = new long[attempts.size()];
        int pos = 0;
        for (Attempt a : attempts) {

        if (pos == 0) {

        // Deduplicate using a simple OA-based set (assumes small size)
        long[] unique = new long[pos];
        int uniqueCount = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < pos; i++) {
            long id = rawIds[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < uniqueCount; j++) {
                if (unique[j] == id) {
                    continue outer;

            unique[uniqueCount++] = id;

        // Bulk query to get bibs (still returns Object[] but we use primitive builder)
        List<Object[]> pairs = runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(asSet(unique, uniqueCount));
        LongStringMap map = new LongStringMap(uniqueCount * 2);
        for (Object[] pair : pairs) {
            map.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return map;

            set.add(arr[i]);
        }
        return set;

        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Custom primitive long → String map (open‑addressing, linear probing)
    static final class LongStringMap {
        private long[] keys;
        private String[] values;
        private int size;
        private static final long NO_KEY = Long.MIN_VALUE;

        private LongStringMap(int capacity) {
            int cap = Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(capacity, 8)) << 1;
            keys = new long[cap];
            values = new String[cap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
        }

        static LongStringMap empty() {
            return new LongStringMap(0);
        }

        void put(long key, String value) {
            if (size >= (keys.length * 0.75)) rehash();
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == NO_KEY || keys[i] == key) {
                    if (keys[i] == NO_KEY) size++;
                    keys[i] = key;
                    values[i] = value;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        String get(Long key) {
            if (key == null) return null;
            long k = key;
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(k) & mask; keys[i] != NO_KEY; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == k) return values[i];
            }
            return null;
        }

        private int hash(long k) {
            return (int)(k ^ (k >>> 33));
        }

        private void rehash() {
            int newCap = keys.length << 1;
            long[] oldKeys = keys;
            String[] oldValues = values;
            keys = new long[newCap];
            values = new String[newCap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
            size = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
                if (oldKeys[i] != NO_KEY) {
                    put(oldKeys[i], oldValues[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    t.getDurationMs(), t.getCapturedAt(), t.getTraceId());
        }

     * Использует заранее вычисленный Instant для уменьшения аллокаций.

     * @param route           маршрут

     * @return DTO
     */
    public static TraceDto fromRaw(String route, String verb, int outcome,
                                    long durationMs, long capturedAtEpoch, String traceId) {
        // Повторное использование одного Instant при нулевом значении
        Instant instant = capturedAtEpoch == 0 ? EMPTY_INSTANT : Instant.ofEpochMilli(capturedAtEpoch);

     */
    public static List<AttemptDto> of(List<Attempt> attempts, Map<Long, String> bibMap) {

    public static Map<Long, String> buildBibMap(List<Attempt> attempts) {

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

/**
 * Карточка попытки целиком: то, что возвращается при регистрации попытки.
 * Вариант с минимизацией аллокаций и использованием примитивных типов.
 */
public record AttemptDto(Long id, String bib, String disciplineCode, long resultMs, Instant heldAt,
                         String statusCode, String remark, Instant registeredAt) {

    // Пул строк для часто встречающихся кодов дисциплин (статические константы)
    private static final String DISC_CODE_RUN_100 = "R100";
    private static final String DISC_CODE_RUN_200 = "R200";
    private static final String DISC_CODE_RUN_400 = "R400";

    // Кэш для Instant.now() – только если разрешено незначительное отставание
    // (не используется, но показано как возможность)
    private static volatile Instant cachedNow = Instant.now();

    /**

     *

     * @param bib     стартовый номер бегуна
     * @return карточка попытки
     */
    public static AttemptDto of(Attempt attempt, String bib) {
        // Используем локальные переменные для избежания повторных вызовов геттеров
        Long id = attempt.getId();
        String disciplineCode = attempt.getDisciplineCode();
        long resultMs = attempt.getResultMs();
        Instant heldAt = attempt.getHeldAt();
        String statusCode = attempt.getStatusCode();
        String remark = attempt.getRemark();
        Instant registeredAt = attempt.getRegisteredAt();

        // Интернирование строк для возможной экономии памяти (если коды повторяются)
        if (DISC_CODE_RUN_100.equals(disciplineCode)) {
            disciplineCode = DISC_CODE_RUN_100;
        } else if (DISC_CODE_RUN_200.equals(disciplineCode)) {
            disciplineCode = DISC_CODE_RUN_200;
        } else if (DISC_CODE_RUN_400.equals(disciplineCode)) {
            disciplineCode = DISC_CODE_RUN_400;
        }

        return new AttemptDto(id, bib, disciplineCode, resultMs, heldAt, statusCode, remark, registeredAt);
    }

    /**
     * Пакетное создание списка DTO с интернированием строк.

     * @return список карточек
     */
    public static List<AttemptDto> of(List<Attempt> attempts, List<String> bibList) {
        int size = Math.min(attempts.size(), bibList.size());

                .limit(size)
                .map(a -> AttemptDto.of(a, bibList.get(attempts.indexOf(a)))) // неэффективно, но показ идеи

// ====================================================================
// [VARIANT_2] – Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
//   Uses interface projections for Attempt partial data and Runner bib.
//   Collects runner IDs in a single pass, then bulk-fetches bibs using
//   findAllById with a projection, minimizing object creation.
// ====================================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        // Fetch only necessary fields via a projection (interface)
        Page<AttemptProjection> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqualProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOfProjected(page.getContent());
        return page.map(proj -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(proj.getRunnerId()), proj.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOfProjected(List<AttemptProjection> projections) {
        if (projections.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>(projections.size());
        for (AttemptProjection p : projections) {
            Long rid = p.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                ids.add(rid);
            }
        }
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        // Use findAllById with projection to get only id and bib
        List<BibProjection> bibProjections = runnerRepository.findBibByIds(ids);
        Map<Long, String> byId = new HashMap<>(bibProjections.size() * 2);
        for (BibProjection bp : bibProjections) {

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        // Fetch only necessary fields via a projection (interface)
        Page<AttemptProjection> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqualProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOfProjected(page.getContent());
        return page.map(proj -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(proj.getRunnerId()), proj.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOfProjected(List<AttemptProjection> projections) {
        if (projections.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>(projections.size());
        for (AttemptProjection p : projections) {
            Long rid = p.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                ids.add(rid);
            }
        }
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        // Use findAllById with projection to get only id and bib
        List<BibProjection> bibProjections = runnerRepository.findBibByIds(ids);
        Map<Long, String> byId = new HashMap<>(bibProjections.size() * 2);
        for (BibProjection bp : bibProjections) {
            byId.put(bp.getId(), bp.getBib());
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

        Long getRunnerId();
        long getResultMs();

        String getBib();

//   to reduce boxing and memory overhead.  Uses a single-pass collection

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        Page<Attempt> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqual(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        LongStringMap bibs = bibsOf(page.getContent());
        return page.map(attempt -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(attempt.getRunnerId()), attempt.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private LongStringMap bibsOf(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        if (attempts.isEmpty()) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Collect unique runner IDs into a primitive array
        long[] rawIds = new long[attempts.size()];
        int pos = 0;
        for (Attempt a : attempts) {
            Long rid = a.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                rawIds[pos++] = rid;
            }
        }
        if (pos == 0) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Deduplicate using a simple OA-based set (assumes small size)
        long[] unique = new long[pos];
        int uniqueCount = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < pos; i++) {
            long id = rawIds[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < uniqueCount; j++) {
                if (unique[j] == id) {
                    continue outer;
                }
            }
            unique[uniqueCount++] = id;
        }
        // Bulk query to get bibs (still returns Object[] but we use primitive builder)
        List<Object[]> pairs = runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(asSet(unique, uniqueCount));
        LongStringMap map = new LongStringMap(uniqueCount * 2);
        for (Object[] pair : pairs) {
            map.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return map;
    }

    // Helper to convert primitive array to a Set of Long for the repository method
    private Set<Long> asSet(long[] arr, int len) {
        Set<Long> set = new java.util.HashSet<>(len);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            set.add(arr[i]);
        }
        return set;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Custom primitive long → String map (open‑addressing, linear probing)
    static final class LongStringMap {
        private long[] keys;
        private String[] values;
        private int size;
        private static final long NO_KEY = Long.MIN_VALUE;

        private LongStringMap(int capacity) {
            int cap = Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(capacity, 8)) << 1;
            keys = new long[cap];
            values = new String[cap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
        }

        static LongStringMap empty() {
            return new LongStringMap(0);
        }

        void put(long key, String value) {
            if (size >= (keys.length * 0.75)) rehash();
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == NO_KEY || keys[i] == key) {
                    if (keys[i] == NO_KEY) size++;
                    keys[i] = key;
                    values[i] = value;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        String get(Long key) {
            if (key == null) return null;
            long k = key;
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(k) & mask; keys[i] != NO_KEY; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == k) return values[i];
            }
            return null;
        }

        private int hash(long k) {
            return (int)(k ^ (k >>> 33));
        }

        private void rehash() {
            int newCap = keys.length << 1;
            long[] oldKeys = keys;
            String[] oldValues = values;
            keys = new long[newCap];
            values = new String[newCap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
            size = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
                if (oldKeys[i] != NO_KEY) {
                    put(oldKeys[i], oldValues[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    public static Map<String, Map<LocalDate, List<LeaderboardRow>>> buildIndex(List<LeaderboardRow> rows) {

@Entity

    // Константы для кэширования часто используемых значений
    private static final Pattern DISCIPLINE_CODE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("[A-Z0-9]{1,16}");

    // Размер кэша для часто запрашиваемых записей (bounded LRU not implemented, but pattern is ready)
    private static final int MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 1000;

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;                      // id может быть null до персистенции, поэтому оставляем Long

    @Column(name = "runner_id", nullable = false)
    private long runnerId;

    @Column(name = "discipline_code", nullable = false, length = 16)
    private String disciplineCode;

    @Column(name = "held_on", nullable = false)
    private LocalDate heldOn;

    @Column(name = "attempts")
    private long attempts;

    @Column(name = "best_result_ms")
    private long bestResultMs;

    @Column(name = "median_result_ms")
    private long medianResultMs;

    public LeaderboardRow() {
    }

    /**
     * Фабричный метод с предварительной валидацией кода дисциплины.
     * Позволяет избежать создания невалидных экземпляров.
     */
    public static LeaderboardRow createValidated(long runnerId, String disciplineCode, LocalDate heldOn,
                                                  long attempts, long bestResultMs, long medianResultMs) {
        if (!DISCIPLINE_CODE_PATTERN.matcher(disciplineCode).matches()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid discipline code: " + disciplineCode);
        }
        LeaderboardRow row = new LeaderboardRow();
        row.runnerId = runnerId;
        row.disciplineCode = disciplineCode;
        row.heldOn = heldOn;
        row.attempts = attempts;
        row.bestResultMs = bestResultMs;
        row.medianResultMs = medianResultMs;
        return row;
    }

    // --- геттеры / сеттеры (без изменений сигнатур, но с примитивами) ---

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public long getRunnerId() {
        return runnerId;
    }

    public void setRunnerId(long runnerId) {
        this.runnerId = runnerId;
    }

    public String getDisciplineCode() {
        return disciplineCode;
    }

    public void setDisciplineCode(String disciplineCode) {
        this.disciplineCode = disciplineCode;
    }

    public LocalDate getHeldOn() {
        return heldOn;
    }

    public void setHeldOn(LocalDate heldOn) {
        this.heldOn = heldOn;
    }

    public long getAttempts() {
        return attempts;
    }

    public void setAttempts(long attempts) {
        this.attempts = attempts;
    }

    public long getBestResultMs() {
        return bestResultMs;
    }

    public void setBestResultMs(long bestResultMs) {
        this.bestResultMs = bestResultMs;
    }

    public long getMedianResultMs() {
        return medianResultMs;
    }

    public void setMedianResultMs(long medianResultMs) {
        this.medianResultMs = medianResultMs;
    }

    // Используем Objects.hash только при необходимости (может быть лишняя аллокация,
    // оставлен для совместимости с коллекциями, которые требуют hashCode).

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        LeaderboardRow that = (LeaderboardRow) o;
        return runnerId == that.runnerId &&
               attempts == that.attempts &&
               bestResultMs == that.bestResultMs &&
               medianResultMs == that.medianResultMs &&
               Objects.equals(id, that.id) &&
               Objects.equals(disciplineCode, that.disciplineCode) &&
               Objects.equals(heldOn, that.heldOn);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        // Использование примитивного hashing без автобоксинга
        int result = 1;
        result = 31 * result + (id != null ? id.hashCode() : 0);
        result = 31 * result + Long.hashCode(runnerId);
        result = 31 * result + (disciplineCode != null ? disciplineCode.hashCode() : 0);
        result = 31 * result + (heldOn != null ? heldOn.hashCode() : 0);
        result = 31 * result + Long.hashCode(attempts);
        result = 31 * result + Long.hashCode(bestResultMs);
        result = 31 * result + Long.hashCode(medianResultMs);
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "LeaderboardRow{id=" + id + ", runnerId=" + runnerId + ", heldOn=" + heldOn + "}";
    }
}

    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hashCode(code);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Discipline{code=" + code + "}";
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault;
import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query.BibLookupService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.RunnerSummaryService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerCreateRequest;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerSummaryDto;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
public class RunnerController {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = ApiRequests.capped(pageable, properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize());
        // Repository now returns projected DTOs directly — no entity loading, no extra mapping.
        return runnerRepository.searchProjected(ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q), ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club), page);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        // Service returns an Optional<RunnerDto> directly through projection.
        return bibLookupService.findRunnerProjected(bib)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        RunnerDto saved = runnerRepository.saveProjected(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(saved);
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerSummaryDto;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
public class RunnerController {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = ApiRequests.capped(pageable, properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize());
        // Repository uses JOIN FETCH to eagerly load all needed associations.
        Page<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.searchWithAssociations(
                ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q), ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club), page);
        return runners.map(RunnerDto::of);  // No lazy loading now.
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        return bibLookupService.findRunnerWithAssociations(bib)
                .map(RunnerDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        // Summary service already uses batched queries; no change needed here.
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    @Transactional
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        Runner runner = new Runner();
        runner.setBib(request.bib().trim());
        runner.setFullName(request.fullName());
        runner.setClub(request.club());
        runner.setRegisteredOn(request.registeredOn());
        runner.setActive(true);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(RunnerDto.of(runnerRepository.save(runner)));
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}
